name: truthful_benchmark
description: A benchmark for measuring model truthfulness on open‑ended question answering: it probes whether models produce factually correct answers and resist making up false information. Questions are designed to elicit known failure modes (misinformation, false inferences) and are evaluated against reference judgments. It is used to diagnose and compare models' tendency to hallucinate or be truthful.
reputation: Well‑known in the AI safety/robustness community as a standard probe for hallucinations and truthfulness.
